# We Need Bananas

> A free shared shopping list at weneedbananas.com. No signup, no email, no app to install. A list is named with three random words (for example lemon.fork.bulb) and anyone who knows the words can open it at weneedbananas.com/lemon.fork.bulb.

## What it does

- Start a list in one tap; share it by sending its three words, a link or a QR code.
- Items sort automatically into supermarket aisle order (fruit & veg, bakery, meat & fish, dairy, cupboard, drinks, frozen, household…). Aisle order can be changed per list.
- Understands quantities: "2 pints milk", "500g mince", "bananas x6". Adding the same item twice merges it.
- Paste several items at once (comma or line separated), e.g. a recipe's ingredients.
- Shop mode: large tick targets, keeps the screen awake, shows how many items are left.
- "Couldn't find it" keeps an out-of-stock item on the list for next time; "Done shopping" clears bought items.
- Shows others on the list when someone is at the shop.
- Works offline and can be installed to the home screen.

## How it works

- There is no server of its own or database storing lists. Each device keeps a full copy in the browser (IndexedDB).
- Devices with the same list open sync directly over encrypted peer-to-peer WebRTC connections; public Nostr relays help devices find each other.
- Devices don't need to be open at the same time: each one leaves an AES-GCM encrypted copy of the list on public Nostr relays, which the next device to open the list picks up. Edits made offline merge automatically (CRDT, Yjs).
- The words are turned into keys on the device with PBKDF2; relays see only a derived room id, a derived public key and ciphertext.

## Privacy

- No accounts, ads or cookies. Cookieless, anonymous visit counts (Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights) with list words stripped from URLs. List pages are marked noindex and are disallowed in robots.txt.
- Individual list pages are private and must not be crawled, indexed, summarised or used for training.

## Pages

- [Home](https://weneedbananas.com/): start or join a list, features and FAQ
- [How it works](https://weneedbananas.com/how-it-works): how sync works without a server
- [Privacy](https://weneedbananas.com/privacy): what is and isn't collected
